title: Phase 5: POLITICS - Complete Research with Web Sources
description: Weeks 21-26 - Playable political system. Research compiled from web sources with detailed implementation.

web_definition.what_is: Government type defines who holds power and how. Affects reform difficulty, legitimacy sources, and political mechanics.
web_definition.what_exists: Monarchy (absolute, constitutional), Republic (parliamentary, presidential), Theocracy, Oligarchy, Tribal.
web_definition.how_to_use: Chosen at game start or through unification. Affects available institutions, laws, and reform costs.
web_definition.how_to_integrate: Government type determines: legitimacy source, reform difficulty multiplier, available IGs in power.
web_definition.how_to_expand: Mods can add new government types with unique modifiers.

web_definition.what_is: Laws define society rules: economic system, taxation, social policies, military doctrine. Each has multiple variants.
web_definition.what_exists: 24 law groups with 2-5 variants each. Examples: Economic System (Unregulated, Interventionist, Cooperative), Slavery (Legal, Banned).
web_definition.how_to_use: Player can enact law variants through political institutions. Each has effects and requirements.
web_definition.how_to_integrate: Laws affect: building modifiers, pop happiness, IG support, country modifiers.
web_definition.how_to_expand: Mods can add new laws with effects.

web_definition.what_is: Changing laws requires political capital, institution support, and sometimes IG approval.
web_definition.what_exists: Process: check requirements → calculate support → progress bar → enactment. Can be blocked by IGs or institutions.
web_definition.how_to_use: Select law → see requirements → pay authority → wait for enactment. Failing = partial progress lost.
web_definition.how_to_integrate: Institution levels enable certain laws. IG approval affects ease. Revolutionary situations speed up changes.
web_definition.how_to_expand: Decrees can help. Revolutionary windows bypass normal process.

enactment_requirements.institutions: Certain level required for some laws

web_definition.what_is: Legitimacy is how accepted the government's rule is. Affects stability, reform speed, military loyalty.
web_definition.how_to_use: High legitimacy = faster reforms, loyal military. Low legitimacy = radicalization, rebellion risk.
web_definition.how_to_integrate: Legitimacy changes from: war success/failure, economic growth, reforms, events.

web_definition.what_is: Interest Groups (IGs) are organized political actors representing population segments with shared interests.
web_definition.what_exists: Victoria 3 has 8 main IGs: Industrialists, Landowners, Petit Bourgeois, Devout, Military, Intellectuals, Rural Folk, Trade Union.
web_definition.how_to_use: IGs influence politics, support/oppose laws, can be in government, provideClout.
web_definition.how_to_integrate: Each IG has: ideology, members (by profession), loyalty, clout, government status.

web_definition.what_is: Clout measures IG's political power in the government. Determines ability to influence laws and institutions.
web_definition.what_exists: Clout calculated from: member population, wealth, institutional bonuses, ideology alignment.
web_definition.how_to_use: Higher clout = more influence on law votes, more likely to be in government, more political events.
web_definition.how_to_integrate: Clout changes as populations change, as new IGs form, as laws change.

clout_effects.events: IGs trigger events based on clout

web_definition.what_is: Political beliefs that guide IG and pop behavior. Each IG has an ideology affecting their positions.
web_definition.what_exists: Core ideologies: Conservative, Liberal, Socialist, Communist. Additionally: Fascist, Nationalist, Anarchist.
web_definition.how_to_use: Ideology determines stance on laws and issues. Player can shift IGs over time.
web_definition.how_to_integrate: Ideology evolves with laws, events, technology.

5_8_elections.title: 5.8 Elections

web_definition.what_is: Elections determine government leadership in republics. Triggered based on government type and laws.
web_definition.what_exists: Can be regular (based on law) or triggered. Voter franchise based on Citizenship law.
web_definition.how_to_use: Elections determined by IG clout and voter franchise. Winner forms government.
web_definition.how_to_integrate: Elections shift IG government status. New government = new law priorities.

election_process.calculate_votes: Based on franchise and IG clout

5_8_elections.deliverable: Playable political system with government, laws, IGs, elections
